title: 第1221章 玄牝空间之来历第1220章 立威丰收
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 赵光正继续清点："此外，四阶仙丹一颗。"
“三阶仙丹·三窍仙丹，一共七颗。”
"其他品类的三阶仙丹为六颗。"
"二阶仙丹三十多颗，一阶仙丹上百颗。"
赵光正咽了咽唾沫，继续道："其余二阶、一阶资材，高阶灵级资材，更是数不胜数。"
"按照封神大世界货币体系估算，此次立宗大典所得贺礼，不低于八万块仙晶。"
八万块仙晶！？
这个数字一出，在场每一位真仙修士都心知肚明其分量。
众人大喜："八万块仙晶？！"
"即便是天仙大能闭关苦修，凝练如此多的仙晶，最快也要八十万年、甚至百万年岁月。"
"对于天仙大能而言，都是一笔巨大财富。"
真仙修士，不过百万年寿元。
天仙修士，不过千万年寿元。
基本没有天仙大能消耗十分之一寿元，只是为了凝练近十万块仙晶。
天仙大能的寿元何等珍贵，百万年光阴足以让他们在封神大世界再上一层楼。
岂会浪费在凝炼仙晶这种事上。
他们大多凭借天仙威力征伐四方，探寻秘境，掠夺资源，从而快速提升修为。
八万多块仙晶，购买力极强，对真仙修士帮助极大，甚至足以培养两三个半步天仙强者。
一颗三窍仙丹便可凝炼三个仙窍，八万块仙晶配合仙丹，足以将数名真仙初期修士推至真仙巅峰，甚至触及半步天仙的门槛。
只可惜，造化仙宗家大业大，所需资源极其海量。
十几万修士的日常修炼消耗，天仙大阵的运转维护，附庸势力的资源供给，每一项都是天文数字。
八万块仙晶看似丰厚，分摊下来后只能满足他们修行一段时间，不足以全都达到真仙巅峰。
第一御极开口："老规矩，按劳分配的同时，兼顾一下按需分配。"
"高阶资源与仙晶，我们大家分一分。"
"低阶资源与天地元石，分给宗门执事、外门大乘期长老，让他们尽快提升实力，冲击渡劫期。"
造化仙宗的分配制度，从诸天万域时期便已成型。
功劳大者多得，需求特殊的照顾一下，二者兼顾，公平合理。
一刻钟后，宗门高层将资源进行了合理分配。
十绝仙子占据大头，她是造化仙宗战力核心，天仙大阵的掌控者，四阶仙丹归她所有，仙晶亦是分得最多。
紫霄仙子、李青元+杨小禾，仅次于十绝仙子。
然后是第一御极、脉主、副脉主、长老级人物，各有所得。
content_en:
Zhao Guangzheng continued to count: "In addition, there is a fourth-level elixir."
"Third-level elixir, three-aperture elixir, seven in total."
"The number of third-level elixirs in other categories is six."
"There are more than thirty second-order elixirs and hundreds of first-order elixirs."
Zhao Guangzheng swallowed his saliva and continued: "There are countless other second-level, first-level materials, and high-level spiritual materials."
"According to the monetary system of the Fengshen World, the gift received from this ancestral ceremony is no less than 80,000 pieces of fairy crystal."
Eighty thousand pieces of fairy crystal! ?
As soon as this number came out, every True Immortal monk present knew its weight.
Everyone was overjoyed: "Eighty thousand pieces of fairy crystal?!"
"Even if a powerful immortal is to practice hard in seclusion, it would take at least 800,000 years or even a million years to condense so many immortal crystals."
"It is a huge wealth for the powerful immortals."
A true immortal monk only lives a million years.
Celestial monks only live for tens of millions of years.
There is basically no immortal power that consumes one-tenth of his life span just to condense nearly 100,000 immortal crystals.
The longevity of the immortals is so precious, a million years is enough for them to reach a higher level in the world of gods.
How could it be wasted on condensing immortal crystals?
Most of them relied on the power of the gods to conquer all directions, explore secret realms, and plunder resources, thereby quickly improving their cultivation.
More than 80,000 pieces of immortal crystals have extremely strong purchasing power and are of great help to true immortal monks. They are even enough to train two or three half-step immortals.
One three-aperture elixir can condense three immortal apertures, and 80,000 immortal crystals combined with the elixir are enough to push several early-stage true immortal monks to the peak of true immortality, and even touch the threshold of half-step immortality.
It's a pity that the Good Fortune Immortal Sect has a great cause and requires extremely large amounts of resources.
The daily cultivation consumption of hundreds of thousands of monks, the operation and maintenance of the Celestial Formation, and the resource supply from the vassal forces are all astronomical figures.
80,000 pieces of immortal crystals may seem rich, but when divided, they can only satisfy their cultivation for a period of time, and are not enough for them all to reach the peak of true immortality.
The first Yuji said: "The old rule is that while allocating resources according to work, we should also consider allocating according to needs."
"High-end resources and fairy crystals, we all share a share."
"Low-level resources and heaven and earth yuan stones are distributed to the sect's deacons and the outer sect's Mahayana elders, so that they can improve their strength as soon as possible and hit the tribulation stage."
The distribution system of the Creation Immortal Sect has been taking shape since the time of All Heavens and All Realms.
Those with greater merit will get more, and they need special care. It is fair and reasonable to take both into consideration.
A quarter of an hour later, the senior leaders of the sect reasonably allocated the resources.
Fairy Shijue occupies the majority. She is the core of the Creation Immortal Sect's combat power and the controller of the Celestial Immortal Formation. She owns the fourth-level elixir and the largest portion of the immortal crystal.
Fairy Zixiao, Li Qingyuan + Yang Xiaohe, second only to Fairy Shijue.
Then there are the first Yuji, the pulse master, the deputy pulse master, and the elders, each with their own gains.
